# Review of the methods

## Summary

The draft describes NASA POWER's monthly temperature at one grid cell, tests for a trend on the training years, and compares a trend-and-season model with naive and seasonal naive forecasts on a hold-out fixed in advance.

## Points to address

1. Test the difference between the trend model and the seasonal naive forecast (Diebold-Mariano with the small-sample correction), or say why it is not tested.
2. Add a rolling-origin evaluation inside the training years to show the ranking is not specific to one origin.

## DIMENSION SCORES
- Overall: 8/10

OVERALL SCORE: 8/10
RECOMMENDATION: Minor Revision
